name: runa
description: A young woman in her twenties, a tracker and hunter. A quiet, alert, light and clear voice, soft-spoken but sure, quick.
reference_text: Quiet. Do you hear that? Something heavy, moving through the ferns to the east. Wolves don't walk like that. Stay low and follow my steps, exactly my steps. There! Behind the birch! Don't run. Never run. Just breathe, and let me take the shot.
